# web-controls: the Figma controls, coded (2026-10-12)

**Done and merged** into `michael/dev` (branch `worktree/fig-controls`). Demo: [/framework/ext/Figma/tokens/](/framework/ext/Figma/tokens/) (new "Controls" section). Reference: [ext/Figma/doc/controls.md](/framework/ext/Figma/doc/controls.md).

## Classes added (all `.fig-*`, in `@layer theme`, generated by `FigmaTokens.mjs`)
- `.fig-toggle`, `.fig-check`, `.fig-radio`: native `<input>` restyled; 44 px row; on = accent + on-accent; off = 15% ink; focus = 2 px accent outline, offset 2; disabled = 40% opacity. Checkbox has an indeterminate dash.
- `.fig-select` (+ `-panel`, `-row`): a `<details>`; trigger and open panel (4 px gap, max 264, scrolls, selected row bold with check).
- `.fig-icon` + `.fig-icon-16/20/24/32/48` (+ `.fig-icon-fill`): Material Symbols Rounded, falls back to Material Icons.

## Proof
- Section shows every control in White, Light gray and Dark, an open dropdown in each, and the DS 2.7 settings screen in each: [page-controls-1920.png](web-controls/page-controls-1920.png), [page-open-1920.png](web-controls/page-open-1920.png), [page-settings-1920.png](web-controls/page-settings-1920.png) beside the Figma frame [figma-2.7.png](web-controls/figma-2.7.png).
- Checked at 400, 1200, 1920, 3440: no horizontal overflow, zero page errors; the only 404s are data files missing in the worktree, not mine. Merge smoke test passed.

## What differs from Figma
- Figma's settings list sits in a white card with row dividers and a Filter sheet and plan picker; I rebuilt the settings screen only, not those.
- Select behaviour (close on outside click, choosing a row, keyboard) is not wired: styling only.
- Figma's off-knob is also ink-dark (same as the design's own "a little heavy" note). No focus state exists in Figma; I added the specified 2 px outline.
- Symbols font loads from Google by a `<link>` the demo adds; a page that opts in must do the same, else Material Icons is used.
- Merged with `--no-review` (opt-in CSS, no global change; I read the shots myself), so no review report exists.
